items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: slept on the couch there and and Sidney lived down the basement with Laura and Butch the dog

ctx.x: is there anything you can tell us about how you all organized those sessions and worked out the different second parts some of them started the remembrance from the time you had your lessons and that you worked together do you think well this was I was still studying with Sidney at the time we made the records and living with him in Brooklyn you were living over there oh yeah well you didn't tell that oh yeah I moved in finally

oh gee I didn't know that see I had been living in New York and and we were having sporadic jobs with the wildcats around town but there were not that many jobs and I was having trouble meeting my 10 or 12 dollars a week rent on my room you know so Sidney said oh that's all right man you come in and move in with me here you know didn't even charge your rent you know no no rent or anything and I took over the front room where he had been giving his lessons and slept on the couch there and and Sidney lived down the…
remember the name of the street and the address and all?
